messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to push the new frontend bundle (v2.14.0) tonight. Target window 22:00 PST. Who's available to run deploy + smoke? Need CDN invalidation + edge-priming checklist.

Maria: I can own the deploy. I'll do a canary slot first, then full swap. Free at 21:30 to prep. Will verify asset hashes and submit CloudFront invalidation.

Jordan: I'll stand by for smoke checks and rollback. Quick tests: login, repo list, dashboard loads, search not 500.

Maria: Invalidation command I plan to run:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E123ABC --paths "/static/*-v2.14.0.*"
```
Also pre-warm by hitting /static/main-<hash>.js from eu-west-1 and us-west-2.

Kinsey: Can you confirm artifact naming? My staging run showed main-2.14.0.12.js vs main-v2.14.0.js

Maria: Artifacts are hashed. I'll grep S3 to get the exact key: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-frontend-assets | grep 2.14.0` and use that filename in the invalidation.

Alex: Ops note — if canary shows >1% 500s in 5m we'll abort and rollback to previous tag. Maria, you want me to trigger rollback or you?

Maria: I'll initiate rollback but will post go/no-go after the 5m canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary slotting started for frontend-canary-2.14.0 at 2063456895

Jordan: Short smoke checklist to run against canary:
- Login as prod user
- Open dashboard, verify graphs load
- Run quick search, verify results
- Create + delete a workspace

Maria: Canary observed a 0.3% 500s spike in first 2m, then stabilized after prefetched assets. Rolling forward to full rollout in 6m. Submitting invalidation now.

deploy-bot: CloudFront invalidation submitted ID: I-9XYZ at 2063456950

Kinsey: Pre-warm script started from eu-west-1 -> hitting /static/main-*.js 100x to edge-nodes.

Alex: Thanks team. If anything looks off, ping me and @oncall-frontend. I'll update the deploy ticket after full swap. :shipit:

Maria: Full swap complete at 2063456998. No regressions in quick checks. Monitoring for 30m.

Jordan: Observability note — console/latency dashboard shows ~120ms 95th after swap, looks healthy.

Alex: Great, will close thread after monitoring window. :tada:
